川普新關稅台灣稅率擬課15% 中國、越南最高20% 美國總統川普再祭新一輪關稅措施，台灣適用稅率曝光！根據《金融時報》（FT）報導，川普政府擬對14個主要貿易夥伴的特定商品加徵新關稅，其中台灣、日本、韓國及歐盟的擬議稅率均為15%，中國及越南則面臨最高20%的關稅，新加坡為10%。此次新關稅不會與今年夏季針對強迫勞動問題所加徵的10%至12.5%關稅疊加，若商品同時適用兩項關稅，將採取兩者中較高的稅率。 1 小時前｜國際 川普新關稅台灣稅率擬課15% 中國、越南最高20% 1 小時前｜國際
heads.en: Trump's new customs tax rate is 15%, China, Vietnam tops 20%, and President Trump's new tax rate is up! According to the Financial Times (FT), the Trump government has introduced new taxes on specific commodities for 14 major trading partners, including 15 per cent in Taiwan, Japan, Korea and the European Union, and up to 20 per cent in China and Viet Nam and 10 per cent in Singapore. This new tax will not be added to the 10 to 12.5 per cent tax added to the forced labor issue this summer, and the higher tax rates will be applied to the two products if they apply the two taxes at the same time. 1 hour ago, 15% of Taiwan's new tax rate in Trump and up to 20% in China and Vietnam.

heads.en: When he shows up in the rain, he's moving into the room! Apologize to Miss Baker for the 20th night of the clean-and-rehabilitating rumours of Miss Bac. "One Village Music Night" was held in the village of the Air Force in New North City and attracted nearly 300 fans. Unexpectedly, the event was moved to the house as a result of sudden rains, and it happened that the special guest Chen Woo-sang started raining even before he left the house. When he arrived, he apologized with humor: "I'm sorry, I came, so it really rained!" and laughed all over. 40 minutes ago, when he showed up at the Big Rain concert, he moved in! I'm sorry, Miss Baker.
